intro: is the recruitment platform built specifically for soccer. Using AI-powered matching, video analysis, and performance data, we help employers hire faster and more efficiently, while giving candidates worldwide the visibility and fair chance they deserve.

connect.card1Title: Get seen by the right clubs.
connect.card1Text: Build a profile that showcases your experience, licenses, and coaching philosophy. Find roles in coaching, analysis, performance, and operations.
connect.card2Text: Post your openings and discover the talent that fits your needs, whether you're a club, academy, college, or agency.
connect.card3Text: Follow open roles, discover the people behind the game, and be part of a growing professional soccer network.

discover.title: What You Will Discover Here
discover.text: Jobsoccer is the first platform built exclusively for the soccer world. Whether you're a player looking for your next club, a coach seeking new opportunities, or an organization searching for the right talent everything you need is in one place. No more relying on personal contacts or word of mouth. Just a smarter, fairer way to connect soccer professionals worldwide.

staffing.title: Specialized in Soccer Staffing
staffing.text: Unlike generic job boards, Jobsoccer is built 100% for the soccer ecosystem. Every feature, every tool, and every connection is designed with the beautiful game in mind.

matching.title: AI-Powered Talent Matching
matching.text: Our smart algorithm analyzes profiles, skills, and requirements to connect the right candidates with the right employers, faster and more accurately.

video.title: AI-Powered Video Interviews
video.text: Go beyond the CV. Every candidate for a position answers the same soccer questions on video, explaining their methodology and approach. Our AI summarizes and scores each answer before the first meeting. Scores support, never replace, the employer’s judgment.

quality.title: Profile Quality Score
quality.text: Every profile is scored for completeness and strength, helping candidates present their best selves and giving employers confidence in what they see.

suggestions.title: AI-Powered Job Suggestions
suggestions.text: No more endless scrolling. Jobsoccer delivers personalized job recommendations to players and staff based on their profile, experience, and preferences.

insights.title: AI Market Insights
insights.text: Stay ahead of the game. Our AI tracks talent trends, in-demand roles, and regional opportunities, so clubs and candidates always know where the market is heading.

global.title: Global Access & Visibility
global.text: Your next opportunity shouldn’t depend on who you know. Jobsoccer gives equal visibility to candidates from every country, every league, and every level of the game.

fair.title: Fair, Transparent, and Structured Process
fair.text: A clear, structured application process that reduces bias and gives every candidate an equal chance.

candidates.subtitle: Stop searching - Start Finding ! Jobsoccer connects you with verified soccer talent worldwide.

how.title: How It Works
how.subtitle: Getting Started is Simple
how.intro: Whether you're looking for your next opportunity or your next signing you're three steps away.

step1.title: Create Your Profile
step1.text: Sign up and build your dynamic professional profile. Add your experience, skills, certifications and upload your video showcase. Let your profile do the talking.

step2.title: Get Discovered or Apply
step2.text: Browse hundreds of job listings across every level of the game. Apply directly or let our AI match you with the right opportunities based on your profile.

step3.title: Connect and Get Hired
step3.text: Message clubs, agents and employers directly. Watch interview requests come to you. Your next soccer career move starts here.

step1.title: Create Your Organization Profile
step1.text: Set up your club, academy, agency or university profile. Tell the soccer world who you are and what you're looking for.

step2.title: Post Jobs or Search Talent
step2.text: Post your openings on our job board or browse our global database of verified candidates — players, coaches, analysts, office staff and more.

step3.title: Shortlist, Watch & Hire
step3.text: Review video interviews, shortlist your favorites, request access to full profiles and connect directly with the talent that fits your vision.
